description: PEP 0010 §4.3, settled in P1a: the channels each device type writes in samples.json, by name and unit; the unit each name's suffix stands for (the longest suffix that matches); and the names that end in a suffix without meaning it.

why.quat_w: a quaternion's w component, unitless (not watts)
why.unsuffixed: t (seconds), the link pose columns <link>_x (the scene's unit, declared in the sidecar) and PEP 0005's clip columns (t0, fps, duration) carry their unit in the sidecar only
